Container.Name: castaway
Container.Overview: Self-hosted single-stream RTMP relay. OBS pushes to a private key, viewers watch in a fullscreen HTML5 player with viewer-side connection diagnostics. Optional Intel QSV ABR transcoding (480p/720p/1080p), optional in-page password gate.
Container.Description: OBS streams to rtmp://<host>:1935/live/<STREAM_KEY>. The key is private — viewers never see it. Open http://<host>:8080/ for the fullscreen player. STREAM_TITLE sets the displayed name. Optional VIEWER_PASSWORD adds a custom in-page login. ABR_MODE=auto + /dev/dri device passthrough enables hardware transcoding via Intel Quick Sync.

Config.Name: Stream key
Config.Description: Private OBS publish password. Generate something random and unguessable. NEVER appears in URLs or the UI. Leave empty to allow anyone to publish (NOT recommended).

Config.Name: Stream title
Config.Description: Displayed name shown to viewers above the player.

Config.Name: Viewer password
Config.Description: If set, viewers must enter this password (in-page login form) to load the player. Leave empty for open access.

Config.Name: ABR mode
Config.Description: auto = QSV if /dev/dri is mounted, else off. Options: auto, qsv, cpu, off.

Config.Name: Intel GPU (for QSV)
Config.Description: Mount your Intel iGPU/Arc GPU for hardware-accelerated ABR transcoding. Remove if you don't have one — ABR will auto-disable.
